header:
# Lunenburg municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 13; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Lunenburg's three selectboard members as Nancy Benoit, Nate Brown, and Harry Williams (Chair)
Town of Lunenburg, Selectboard reorganization meeting notes, March 16, 2026: the board is Harry Williams (Chair), Nancy Benoit, and Nate Brown

Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Gary Briggs is Town Clerk (one-year remainder of term); the town's published 2026 candidate list seats him for a full three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Gary Briggs as Lunenburg's town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Gary Briggs as Lunenburg's town clerk contact
Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Gary Briggs is Town Treasurer; the town's published 2026 candidate list seats him for a full three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Gary Briggs as Lunenburg's treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Gary Briggs as Lunenburg's town treasurer contact

Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Jacob Fournier is Moderator; the town's published '2026 Town Officer Candidates' list names him the only candidate for Moderator

Town of Lunenburg, notes of the March 3, 2026 annual town meeting: the meeting notes record the Town Clerk presiding only because 'Moderator Jacob was ill', treating Fournier as the sitting Moderator. Minted under the sole-candidate exception (incumbent plus the only name on the town's published candidate list), disclosed on issue #163
Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Luke Robinson is Auditor (three-year term elected 2025)

Town of Lunenburg, Auditors meeting minutes, June 29, 2026: the auditors' own minutes seat Luke Robinson and Karla Colby, with Jim Moffitt absent: the sitting three-member board. Colby was the published 2026 candidate for the three-year seat; Moffitt's seat is the second auditor seat the 2025 warning carried, unnamed in the report's elected list

Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Karen Danforth is Lister (three-year term elected 2025). The 2026 candidates for the remaining seats (Linda Magoni, three-year; Sonya Boulay, one-year) are not minted: candidates are not winners and no outcome is published

Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Penny Nason is Cemetery Commissioner (elected 2025). One three-year seat is elected per year, deriving a three-seat commission; the 2026 candidate (Deb Thomas) is not minted, as no outcome is published
Town of Lunenburg, 2025 Town Report: '2025 Elected Town Officers' list: Dan Comeau was elected Constable in 2025

Town of Lunenburg, Selectboard reorganization meeting notes, March 16, 2026: the Selectboard's annual appointments list 'Constable: Dan Comeau', and the board recorded asking VLCT about eliminating the position from town appointments; the current holder is recorded as appointed

Town of Lunenburg, Auditors meeting minutes, June 29, 2026: the auditors' minutes name Cindi Wilmoti the sitting Delinquent Tax Collector (the town report spells the name 'Cindy Wilmott' once in a committee list; the minutes spelling is recorded). The office is filled by appointment

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): names three justices of the peace for Lunenburg: James Peyton, Diane Peyton, and Wyatt Peyton
